opening: I have a cough bringing up phlegm.
The breathlessness and cough came on suddenly 2 days ago, together with the fever, chills, aches and chest pain.
I have chest pain that gets worse when I breathe in.
Since childhood I've been admitted to hospital many times for pneumonia that keeps coming back.
In the past five years I also had one episode of Mycobacterium avium-intracellulare infection.

opening.text: I've been short of breath and have a cough bringing up phlegm. The breathlessness and cough came on suddenly 2 days ago, together with the fever, chills, aches and chest pain. I've had a fever. I've had chills. I have chest pain that gets worse when I breathe in. Since childhood I've been admitted to hospital many times for pneumonia that keeps coming back, and in the past five years I also had one episode of Mycobacterium avium-intracellulare infection. My father had emphysema.
